summary: A FastAPI JSON service in Python with typed routes, one error format, request-id logs and a committed OpenAPI spec.
description: Start a Python HTTP API on FastAPI and Uvicorn with no frontend. An app factory, settings and lifespan keep startup testable; routes return one error envelope, and middleware tags every log line with a request id. Tests run the real app in process, and a drift check keeps the committed OpenAPI spec in step with the code. The example resource lives in memory: add postgres for a database, and build authentication yourself.
seoDescription: A FastAPI service recipe with uv, ruff, mypy and pytest, structlog request logs, one error envelope and an OpenAPI drift check.

projectExamples.title: Internal pricing service
projectExamples.description: Expose pricing rules as typed FastAPI endpoints that other services call. The rules, their storage and caller authentication are your work.

projectExamples.title: Field report intake API
projectExamples.description: Add postgres to store submitted reports, then build validated create and list endpoints on it. Access control and file uploads need their own design.
